Rooms.Name: The gates of the Minotaur Village
Rooms.Description:
Directly south you see a huge pair of gates. These gates appear to be 
carved almost completely out of wood. A huge city appears to be on the 
other side of these gates. There is also a possibility of going back 
north.

Exits.Description: To the south is a strong, sturdy gate.

Rooms.Name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
You walk among the various shops and homes. Most of the doors are 
closed and only the light from the windows betrays the presence of 
inhabitants. A cold wind blows through here. Small streets lead south 
and east.

Rooms.Name: Inside the gates of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
You stand just inside the gates to the city of Mahn-Tor. The city 
itself spreads out in front of you. The buildings are sturdy, as they 
appear to be made from the very hard rock. Small city streets lead east 
and west, while a main road appears to lead south.

Rooms.Name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
You trudge among the streets of Mahn-Tor. The streets themselves are 
made of cobblestone and are quite treacherous. Small homes and 
businesses along the street are closed tight and light from their 
windows throws eerie shadows across the dark street. Small streets lead 
west and south here.

Rooms.Name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
You trudge through the streets of the city. The street itself is made 
of cobblestones and the footing is quite treacherous. To the south, you 
see what appears to be a small tavern. Bright lights shine through the 
windows. Small streets also lead north and east. A small sign hangs 
outside the tavern.

Rooms.Name: The Square of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
This appears to be the main square of Mahn-Tor. Small streets lead 
east and west. To the north, you see the gates to the city. You also 
notice a small store to the south. A small sign hangs outside the store.

Rooms.Name: The streets of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
You walk among the small stores and homes of Mahn-Tor. The wind blows
fiercely. Small streets lead in all directions. There appears to be a 
large building to the east, but the sun obscures your view.

Rooms.Name: The Inn of the Broken Horn
Rooms.Description:
You enter a warm tavern. The room is lit mainly by two huge 
fireplaces at each end of the room. Small tables and a large bar furnish 
the room. The inhabitants of the inn are all minotaurs of varying size 
and disposition. Most seem to regard you with suspicion. Few approach 
you. A large door leads north, out of the bar and back out into the 
city, and some stairs are leading up.

Rooms.Name: The Mahn-Tor Equipment Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are in a crude equipment shop. The store is filled with racks of 
various items that adventurers could use. Large fireplaces light and 
heat the room. A large desk occupies the back of the room. The door to 
the shop lies to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Mahn-Tor General Store
Rooms.Description:
You enter a small store that is dark and cold. Old empty shelves line 
the walls and dust blows across the stony floor. It is evident that this 
store was once used, but it is no more. A small doorway leads north out 
into the streets of the city.

Rooms.Name: Aegithus's Training Room
Rooms.Description:
This room is full of all sorts of weapons and armors. Pieces of old 
targets and practice dummies lie all around. The walls are chipped and 
scored from weapon blows. This is obviously the room of an avid warrior. 
A red door leads east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

Rooms.Name: Pythian's Dark Study
Rooms.Description:
This room is dark. It reeks of death and evil. A black door leads east.
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

Rooms.Name: Creon's Inner Sanctum
Rooms.Description:
Idols to Dirk fill the room. White furniture and decorations give the 
room a holy appearance. It is evident that some being of supreme 
goodness lives here. A white door leads east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads out to the hall.

Rooms.Name: The road to the Keep of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
You walk up a steep rocky road. It leads up a steep grade to the 
east. At the end of this steep road, you see a huge keep. Dust swirls 
all about you and you feel your throat itch from breathing. Blurry 
lights to the east and west are all you can see from here.

Rooms.Name: A small guard house
Rooms.Description:
You enter a small guard house. A huge fireplace lights and warms the 
room. Looking around, you see that the room is fairly well furnished. 
Thick rugs and curtains help insulate the room and the beds themselves 
look quite warm. A table in the center of the room has the remnants of 
a card game strewn across it. A small door leads south.

Rooms.Name: Before the Keep of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
You stand before a huge keep that has been carved into the side of 
the mountain. Huge wooden gates before you provide entrance to the keep. 
It appears as though the storm here has convinced the guards to seek 
shelter inside. You see the lights of the city to the west. You also 
notice small guard houses to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: A small guard house
Rooms.Description:
You enter a small, but warm, guard house. Deep rugs and thick 
curtains insulate the room. A huge fireplace lights and warms the room. 
Outside, you hear the roar of the wind. A small door leads north out 
into the street.

Rooms.Name: The entryway to the Keep of Mahn-Tor
Rooms.Description:
You are at the entry hall to the huge keep. The high vaulted ceiling 
is carved from solid stone. Huge stone pillars rise up from the floor to 
meet the ceiling far above. The architecture appears to be dwarven. A 
huge pair of gates stand to the west, protecting the keep from the harsh 
wind outside. A large hall leads east, deeper into the keep.

Rooms.Name: The Hall
Rooms.Description:
You are in a huge hall. Large tapestries line the walls and huge 
statues of various make and appearance are spread about. The ceiling 
above supports huge candelabras, which light the room. To the east, you 
see a bright light and hear sounds of inhabitation. Looking west, you 
see the entry gates to the keep.

Rooms.Name: The Grand Hall
Rooms.Description:
You are in the main hall of the Keep of Mahn-Tor. This hall is huge. 
The wide floor of the hall is an expanse of marble. It shimmers in the 
light thrown off by the torches that line the walls. To the east, you 
see what appears to be a huge golden throne. The hall itself stretches 
south and a smaller hall leads to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Great Hall
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the great hall of the keep. Huge pillars rise up to the 
vaulted ceiling and torch light glimmers off the marble floor here. You 
are amazed at the sheer size of the hall. The hall itself leads north 
and east. You notice a smaller hall leading south, deeper into the keep.

Rooms.Name: Standing before the throne
Rooms.Description:
You stand before the throne of Xanthias. This golden throne is so 
huge that it takes up almost the entire wall, stretching far above the 
floor. Sitting upon it, you feel small and feeble. It is evident that 
this throne is more of a decoration than anything else. Only the largest 
of kings could sit upon it. The hall leads south and west into other 
parts of the keep.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The golden throne is huge. It takes up the whole wall.........

Rooms.Name: The Great Hall
Rooms.Description:
You are in a great hall. Huge torches light the room and their light
shimmers off the marble floor below you. To the north, you see a huge 
golden throne. Looking up, you grow dizzy at the height to which the 
vaulted ceiling rises. The hall itself leads north and west.

Rooms.Name: The secret hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small, torch lit hall. It leads from east to west. A 
large gold door is to the west. To the east, you see a heavy stone door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Looks like the back of a secret door of sorts.
A very formidable looking door.

Rooms.Name: Entry to the Royal Chambers
Rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to the royal chambers of the keep. A plush 
shag rug covers the stone floor. Large candelabras hang from the 
ceiling, lighting the room. A huge fireplace warms the room. Beaded 
doorways lead south and east. A huge stone door stands in the west wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A huge stone door.......

Rooms.Name: The Guard Post
Rooms.Description:
The hall here has been built into a guard post of sorts. It appears 
as though it would be quite easy to defend in times of emergency. 
Obviously, something important lies beyond. A small hall leads south, 
while the main hall can be seen to the north.

Rooms.Name: The guarded hall
Rooms.Description:
You walk down a torch lit hallway. It has been carved out of pure 
stone. It is very quiet in this hall. You notice rows of colored doors 
on each wall. To your east, you see a yellow door. To your west, you see 
a red door. The hall itself leads south and north.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a red door. It has the name "Aegithus" written on it.
You see a yellow door. It has the name "Jocasta" written on it.

Rooms.Name: The guarded hall
Rooms.Description:
You walk down a small, quiet, torch lit hallway. Doors of different 
colors are in each wall. To your east, you see a maroon door. To your 
west, you see a black door. The hall itself leads north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a black door. It has the name "Pythian" inscribed on it.
You see a maroon door here. It has the name "Haemon" written on it.

Rooms.Name: Jocasta's Sanctum
Rooms.Description:
You enter a temple of sorts. A small altar is here and relics of many
religions lie around. It is evident that this is the room of a studying 
cleric. A yellow door leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

Rooms.Name: Haemon's Arcane Study
Rooms.Description:
This room is full of shelves which hold various spell components. The 
center of the room is occupied by a huge pentagram. The entire room 
smells of smoke and incense. The room is obviously used extensively by a 
practicing mage. A maroon door leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

Rooms.Name: The guarded hall
Rooms.Description:
You walk down a quiet hall. The stone walls here are wet with 
moisture. Colored doors can be seen in the walls here. To your east, you 
see a green door. To your west, you see a white door. The hall itself 
leads north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a white door here. It has the name "Creon" inscribed on it.
You see a green door here. It has the name "Thesus" written on it.

Rooms.Name: The Harem Room
Rooms.Description:
This appears to be the harem room of the Keep. Huge piles of furs and 
beds fill the room. The lighting is dim, but the room is very warm. You 
can hear music playing quietly from somewhere. Beaded doorways lead 
north and east.

Rooms.Name: Thesus's Humble Abode
Rooms.Description:
This room is filled with all types of natural items. Trees and plants 
have been lovingly cultivated and grown by hand, in large pots. The room 
is like an indoor garden. A green door leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

Rooms.Name: The main living room
Rooms.Description:
This room is decorated with sturdy stone furniture that is carved and
gilded. Large candles light the room. A thick rug covers the floor. 
Thick furs and tapestries decorate the walls. Beaded doorways lead south 
and west.

Rooms.Name: The Master Bedroom
Rooms.Description:
This appears to be the master bedroom. A huge bed fills the rooms. 
Piles of furs and other rich furnishings adorn the room. Candles are 
everywhere and they help a huge fireplace light the room. The lavishness 
of the room overwhelms you. Beaded doorways lead north and west.

Rooms.Name: The end of the guarded hall
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of the hall. Colored doors line the walls to the 
north. To your west, you see a brown door. To you east, you see a grey 
door. The hall itself leads north back along the rows of doors.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a brown door here. It has the name "Balthazar" written on it.
You see a grey door here. It has the name "Astyanax" written on it.

Rooms.Name: Astyanax's Dismal Domicile
Rooms.Description:
This room is dirty and unkempt. Odds and ends of different items lie 
all over. It is apparent that some type of pack-rat lives here. It 
appears as though nothing has ever entered this room and ever left 
again. A grey door leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

Rooms.Name: Balthazar's Green Room
Rooms.Description:
This room is full of green. The furniture and all other items show 
the color of nature. The room smells of pine and forest odors. From the 
items here, it appears as though a woodsman of some sorts lives here. 
A brown door leads east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads to the hall.

Rooms.Name: The Corridor of the Broken Horn
Rooms.Description:
This corridor is clean and spotless. A nice carpet with motives of 
great battles covers the floor. There are doors to the east and west, 
marked with the roomnumbers and the stairs are leading back down.

Rooms.Name: A room in the Broken Inn.
Rooms.Description:
Someone is obviously living here, since the bed is unmade and an open 
coffert is standing in the middle of the room. The door is leading back
west and there is a door marked with a heart to the north, and you guess
it must be the bathroom.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The coffert is filled with minotaur underwear. They are not your size 
though.

Rooms.Name: A guard post
Rooms.Description:
A small sentrybox is here to shelter the guards from the weather.  
A well traveled path is leading north into a military camp.

Rooms.Name: In the camp
Rooms.Description:
The dusty ground bares witness of heavy exercise.  The camp continues
further to the north, and there is a guard post to the south.  Your east
and west side is flanked by huge green tents.

Rooms.Name: Among the tents
Rooms.Description:
To the north is a larger tent, obviously hosting someone important, 
since it is marked with a banner.  There are smaller tents to your east 
and west, and a path leading back through the camp.

Rooms.Name: The warriors sleeping quarters
Rooms.Description:
This tent is in perfect order, not the slightest speck of dust is 
visible and the beds are made so tight that you wonder if they ever has 
been unmade.

Rooms.Name: The warriors living quarters
Rooms.Description: This tent is almost ready for inspection, the beds are however unmade.

Rooms.Name: The officers tent
Rooms.Description:
This tent is filled with trophys bearing witness of many glorious 
battles, and it is in flawless order, since the minotaur officers take 
pride in beeing a good example for their soldiers.

Rooms.Name: The warriors living quarters
Rooms.Description:
This tent is, like the rest, in a very good order.  A chest for 
personal belongings is standing in a corner, and there is a chair 
standing by one of the beds.

Rooms.Name: The colonels tent
Rooms.Description:
A thick expensive looking carpet is lying on the floor, and there are
trophys from many won battles standing all over.  A large desk is 
standing in the middle of the tent, covered with maps and other papers 
concering battle tactics.

Rooms.Name: A Bathroom
Rooms.Description:
A bathtub is standing in the middle of the room, filled with warm
water. The mirror is foggy and it looks like someone recently has taken
a bath.

Rooms.Name: A bedroom in the Broken Inn
Rooms.Description:
In here it is neat and tidy like the rest of the inn. The bed is made 
and a fireplace is providing light and heat to this room.

Mobs.Name: citizen minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur citizen is here, hurrying through streets.
Mobs.Description:
You see a rather ragged minotaur. It appears that it is in too much of a hurry
to stop and chat.

Mobs.Name: guard minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur guard patrols the area.
Mobs.Description: This minotaur is not too happy at your appearance in his beloved city.

Mobs.Name: warrior minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur warrior is here looking for trouble.
Mobs.Description:
You see a huge, musclebound minotaur that is covered in blood. The very sight
of him makes you cringe in terror.

Mobs.Name: minotaur gatekeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur is here guarding the Keep of Minotaurs.
Mobs.Description:
The minotaur stands rigidly before the gates of the keep. It looks 
quite miserable, but then again with the recent layoffs and the lousy 
health benefents, so would you.

Mobs.Name: minotaur high guard
Mobs.LongDescription: The high minotaur guard is here guarding the Keep.
Mobs.Description:
The high guard is dressed in glittering armor. She looks quite dangerous and
skilled.

Mobs.Name: minotaur royal guard
Mobs.LongDescription: The royal minotaur guard orders you to leave at once.
Mobs.Description:
The royal guard is quite huge. He is dressed in magnicifant armor.  He does not
like pests.

Mobs.Name: guard minotaur elite
Mobs.LongDescription: The elite minotaur guard watches your every move.
Mobs.Description: This minotaur does not look like the talkative type, better leave him alone.

Mobs.Name: girl haremgirl harem slave
Mobs.LongDescription: A harem girl cowers here in fear.
Mobs.Description:
She looks quite attractive. Her low cut gown reveals why she was chosen to be
in the harem.

Mobs.Name: butler minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur butler stands here rigidly, awaiting orders.
Mobs.Description: He looks quite regal and refined to be a minotaur.

Mobs.Name: keeper minotaur keymaster
Mobs.LongDescription: The Minotaur Keymaster stands guarding his post.
Mobs.Description: He looks mean......what more is there to say?

Mobs.Name: aegithus minotaur warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: Aegithus, the Minotaur Warrior, is here practicing his skills.
Mobs.Description: Aegithus is HUGE. His muscles are bigger than you!

Mobs.Name: pythian minotaur mage
Mobs.LongDescription: Pythian, the Minotaur Mage, stands here grinning wickedly.
Mobs.Description:
Pythian is a living incarnation of evil. He radiates a dark aura, and 
a cold chill runs down your spine.

Mobs.Name: creon minotaur cleric
Mobs.LongDescription: Creon, the Minotaur Cleric, is here worshipping silently.
Mobs.Description:
Creon is the minotaur incarnation of good. You feel safe and at ease in 
his presence.

Mobs.Name: haemon minotaur mage
Mobs.LongDescription: Haemon, the Minotaur Mage, is here chanting songs by R.E.M.
Mobs.Description: Haemon is a small minotaur, and one heck of a dancer.

Mobs.Name: jocasta minotaur cleric
Mobs.LongDescription: Jocasta, Minotaur Cleric, is here looking hungry.
Mobs.Description: He is another good-hearted soul.

Mobs.Name: thesus minotaur warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: Thesus, the minotaur Warrior is here studying the arts of ninjitsu.
Mobs.Description: Thesus is quite a nasty looking minotaur.

Mobs.Name: balthazar minotaur thief
Mobs.LongDescription: Balthazar, the Minotaur Thief, looks unhappy about having visitors.
Mobs.Description:
Balthazar looks quite agile and thin, when compared to the normal minotaur. He
looks at you with a slight smirk.

Mobs.Name: astyanax minotaur thief
Mobs.LongDescription: Astyanax, the Minotaur Thief, greedily keeps track of his money.
Mobs.Description: Astyanax is tall and slender, unlike most minotaurs.

Mobs.Name: xanthias minotaur grand warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: Xanthias, the Minotaur Grand Warrior, is here looking down at you.
Mobs.Description:
Xanthias towers above you. He is simply huge. You can see why he is 
the leader of the Minotaurs.

Mobs.Name: innkeeper minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur innkeeper watches his customers suspiciously.
Mobs.Description:
He looks like he is ready to defend his inn, even when it is not really
needed...

Mobs.Name: citizen minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur citizen is here, working on getting drunk.
Mobs.Description: You see a rather ragged minotaur.

Mobs.Name: minotaur janitor
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur janitor is here, dusting frantically.
Mobs.Description:
I don't feel like writing a description here, since no one bothers to
read it anyway.
Mobs.ActionScript: %1 l;%20 emote mutters something sourly about cleaning and not wanting to do it.

Mobs.Name: minotaur man naked
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur is standing here, with a towel wrapped around his waist.
Mobs.Description: He looks slightly disturbed by you entering the room...
Mobs.ActionScript: %1 l;%40 say Hey! Get out of here! I'm taking a bath!

Mobs.Name: minotaur guard warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur warrior is standing here, guarding the entrance to the camp.
Mobs.Description: He looks ragged and fierce like the rest of the minotaurs.
Mobs.ActionScript: %1 l;%5 whistle; %10 emote grunts.;%5 emote mutters about the weather and having to stand here.

Mobs.Name: warrior minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur warrior is marching around here.
Mobs.Description:
You see a huge, musclebound minotaur that is covered in blood. The very sight
of him makes you cringe in terror.

Mobs.Name: warrior sergeant minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur sergeant is standing to attention, ready for inspection.
Mobs.Description: He looks very disturbed by your intruision.

Mobs.Name: warrior minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur warrior is standing to attention by his bed.
Mobs.Description: He looks like he is very proud of how well made his bed is.

Mobs.Name: warrior minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur warrior is here, making his bed.
Mobs.Description: He looks mean......what more is there to say?

Mobs.Name: warrior minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur warrior is here, polishing his boots.
Mobs.Description: He looks mean......what more is there to say?

Mobs.Name: warrior captain minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur captain is busy polishing his medals.
Mobs.Description:
He looks he has been trough a lot of battles, and he is probably
quite good at fighting since he has receives so many rewards.

Mobs.Name: warrior lieutenant minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur lieutenant is here, pretending he is a captain.
Mobs.Description:
He looks he has been trough a lot of battles, and he is probably
quite good at fighting since he has receives so many rewards.

Mobs.Name: warrior minotaur colonel
Mobs.LongDescription: The minotaur colonel is sitting behind his desk, studying battle tactics.
Mobs.Description:
He looks very important, and it looks like it would be a bad idea to
upset him.

Mobs.Name: warrior bodyguard guard minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: A bodyguard is here on duty.
Mobs.Description: He looks like he is doing a good job with protecting the colonel.

Objects.Name: axe great
Objects.Description: Xanthias' Great Axe

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The words "Death" are scrawled along the blade.

Objects.Name: key keep
Objects.Description: the Keep key is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Just an ordinary key.

Objects.Description: A Whiteish key is here.

Objects.Description: A Brownish key is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has a brownish color.

Objects.Name: key yellowish
Objects.Description: A Yellowish key is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has a yellowish color.

Objects.Name: key maroonish
Objects.Description: A Maroonish key is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has a maroonish color.

Objects.Name: key greenish
Objects.Description: A Greenish key is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has a greenish color.

Objects.Name: key greyish
Objects.Description: A Greyish key is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has a greyish color.

Objects.Name: key runed
Objects.Description: A Runed key is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key looks like it was made for royalty.

Objects.Name: gloves combat
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of minotaur combat gloves
Objects.Description: A pair of metal plated gloves lie here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These gloves are plated with metal plates that provide strength and 
protection.

Objects.Name: spiked gauntlets
Objects.Description: A pair of spiked gauntlets lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They look pretty damaging.

Objects.Name: breast plate gilded gold
Objects.Description: A large golden breast plate lies here.

Objects.Name: girdle pouches many
Objects.Description: A girdle lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It appears to be full of tiny pockets.

Objects.Name: bracelet thick marble
Objects.Description: A thick bracelet made of marble lies here.

Objects.Name: crossbow huge
Objects.Description: A huge crossbow rests here.

Objects.Name: pack leather small
Objects.Description: A small leather pack rests here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks pretty big on the inside.

Objects.Name: sword kopesh
Objects.Description: A sword with a curved blade lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sword looks like it would be grasped so that the blade extended 
along the forearm of the wielder.

Objects.Name: axe battle battleaxe
Objects.Description: A dangerous looking battle axe rests here.

Objects.Name: vambraces blue steel
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of blue steel vambraces
Objects.Description: Some vambraces made of blue steel rest here.

Objects.Name: greaves red steel
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of red steel greaves
Objects.Description: Some greaves made of red steel rest here.

Objects.Name: visor helm crimson steel
Objects.ShortDescription: a crimson steel helm and visor
Objects.Description: A helm and visor made of crimson steel rests here.

Objects.Name: plate steel breast
Objects.Description: A breast plate of thick steel rests here.

Objects.Name: broach ivory
Objects.Description: A small ivory broach lies here.

Objects.Name: spiked armor garde
Objects.ShortDescription: a suit of spiked garde armor
Objects.Description: A pile of spiked chainmail lies here.

Objects.Name: greaves black
Objects.ShortDescription: A pair of black minotaur greaves
Objects.Description: Some black metal greaves lie here.

Objects.Name: vambraces black
Objects.ShortDescription: A pair of black minotaur vambraces
Objects.Description: Some black metal vambraces lie here.

Objects.Name: rod weaponry
Objects.Description: A shiny metal rod lies here.

Objects.Name: cloak pitch black
Objects.Description: A pile of black cloth lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It appears to have pockets inside it.

Objects.Name: neckguard neck guard black plate
Objects.Description: A black plate collar rests here.

Objects.Name: shield shadow
Objects.Description: A shadowy shield rests here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You look into the depths of the shield and shiver at the evil it contains.

Objects.Name: nightbringer short sword shortsword
Objects.Description: A very evil looking shortsword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The runes "Nightbringer" are scrawled along the blade.

Objects.Name: visor helm golden
Objects.Description: A helm and visor made of pure gold rests here.

Objects.Name: cape white billowing silk
Objects.Description: A pile of white silk lies here.

Objects.Name: shield huge tower
Objects.Description: A huge shield lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A pure white shield with a gold cross emblazoned across it.

Objects.Name: dawnbringer mace huge
Objects.Description: A huge mace lies here. It radiates an aura of power.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The runes "Dawnbringer" are scrawled along the handle.

Objects.Name: spectacles wire rimmed
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of wire rimmed spectacles
Objects.Description: A small pair of wire rimmed spectacles rests here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They'll make you look smart.

Objects.Name: ring banded
Objects.Description: A small ring made of gold and silver bands lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ring has entwined bands of gold and silver.

Objects.Name: globe minor
Objects.Description: A small globe rests here. It shimmers and radiates power.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Shimmering colors move inside the globe.
